display_name: PAMF 物理分支自适应参考梯度预算单种子对照
description: 当前源训练批次的参考参数梯度范数决定有界物理关系剂量。
authorization: 2026-11-10 用户要求训练机制兼具多分支与物理感知，并授权 N607 GPU 0/1 每卡两个实验进程。

code.commit: Recorded immutable release commit in runtime.json at launch
code.environment: N607 existing project Python, FP32/TF32 off, no installs

data.contract_ref: F0 same source contract and validated target handles in private runtime context
data.physical_ids_ref: F0 target physical IDs; weak view manifest physical_ids_ref

roles.L_s: true labels; up to 64 source records per L step for echo directions
roles.U_s: hidden TX; ordinary PL threshold .95; select at most 128 U independently of acceptance, use accepted subset for relations
roles.V: 27000 source validation, no training or checkpoint selection

data.validation_ref: previous VALIDATED_ONCE; Phase2 capsule/split not applicable
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 fixed prediction only; Phase2 support/query not applicable

permissions.claim_scope: single-seed exploratory, previously exposed benchmark; no general or statistical claim

checkpoint.initialization: matched F21 scratch E20, then own 10+20; no prior candidate checkpoint
sources: same-contract F21 scratch E20; preexisting ordinary PL seven-view scores; previous PL weak scores if complete
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: pamf_physics_branch.source.checked_parent using actual F21 payload and source roles
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Actual parent contract and scratch checkpoint inspected at load; fail on mismatch
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E50; no target selection or tuning

execution.gpu_policy: GPU 0/1; fixed reference-budget owner must be terminal with matched scores available; max two total observed/pending workers per card
execution.stop_rule: Systemic training/prediction/scoring failure stops new dispatch; isolated source diagnostic failure is recorded and does not cancel frozen-model predictions; preserve healthy workers and artifacts

expected_artifacts: one-row real E20 no-query finite-backward and adaptive-budget smoke
own E30 and E50 source trajectories, reference scale statistics, L/U physical exposure counts and resource costs
full source L/V physical diagnostics and stratified original As
all practical and weak predictions frozen before independent truth-last scoring
same-row comparison to equal beta=0.5, fixed reference 0.1 and ordinary PL

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: separate CPU scorer, after all same-row predictions

rows.method: PTBR beta=0.5 + detached adaptive reference gradient budget
rows.purpose: compare source-batch adaptive, equal and fixed reference relation budgets
rows.seed_notes: Original F0 seeds; echo has fixed source RNG by global step; weak view seeds in manifest; no support.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical in three F0 populations; raw three weak scenes on combined target
rows.budget_ref: reused E20/4440; own E10+E20/6660; same L64/U<=128 physical directions; two extra reference-gradient evaluations each step

notes: Base gradient uses original supervised and ordinary PL losses from the current source batch; relation gradient uses the physical reference L/U terms after the registered five-branch mean.
Scale=clip(||base||/(||relation||+1e-12),.1,1); zero relation gives 1. Detached scalar, no V initialization, no target or U labels; other branches and all base losses unchanged.
The .1 floor means the reference relation is not guaranteed below the base norm; no Adam-update or identity-preservation guarantee.
Same source exposures and optimization steps as equal beta=.5; two extra reference-parameter autograd evaluations each update, so training compute is not matched.
Fixed prior to reference-budget target scoring. Historical F0 benchmark already exposed; report limitations and no target-driven selection or retries.
Before expansion, final V no worse than original PL by .2 pp and equal beta=.5 by .1 pp; report nonfinite skips, anchors, scale and source diagnostics; do not cancel fixed pilot tests.
Wait until fixed-budget owner is terminal with matched scores available; all candidate predictions precede truth-last scoring. Source diagnostics run but do not gate fixed candidate predictions.
